notes.title: "Hunter: Space Pirates - Chapter 3" DLC Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Mary is faced with a new revelation, brought to her by a woman claiming to know Brad. How will this affect [b]Hunter[/b]'s destiny? Meanwhile, Bradok and his team find themselves lost in the uncharted depths of Sandsora, facing dangerous challenges that will test their wits.

Out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3911510/Hunter_Space_Pirates__Chapter_3/

notes.title: Name Changer Added
notes.content:
This small update allows you to change the custom names more freely!

Just go to the game menu and click on the "Name Changer" button at the top.

notes.title: Chapter 2: Second Half Update!
notes.content:
Who smashed the window at Megan's house? What’s weighing on Kimmy’s mind? Can Bradok break free from his imprisonment? And what does Principal Stickland have in store for Hunter? All these questions (and more) will be answered in this update!

notes.title: Path Viewer Update!
notes.content:
We're introducing the "Path Viewer". This new menu will allow you to replay scenes featuring a specific romantic interest (Currently Megan, Betty and Kimmy). As you play through the game, these scenes will unlock. Just load your latest save and look for the "Path Viewer" menu.

Replay the girls' key moments with the press of a button. Simply select a character and relive their story at any time!

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
It's now possible to automatically unlock the relationship paths with all the girls! This will work even after having passed the in-game choices that lead to these paths.

Just load your save file and press the "Unlock all paths" button on the game menu.
[i](Make sure to save your game after clicking this button).[/i]

notes.title: Extra Content
notes.content: Extra content is now available from the main menu! You just need to have the "OG Supporter" achievement unlocked.

notes.title: Big Announcement
notes.content:
We would like to announce that [i][b]Hunter: Space Pirates[/b][/i] is going [b]FREE TO PLAY[/b]!

After much thought, Mr. Mister and team, has decided that making the base game a free experience will be the best course of action, as well as reducing the price for the Chapter 2 DLC. These changes will happen on January 13.

We appreciate all the support you have given us! Without it we wouldn't have been able to continue developing this game.

If you bought the game previous to this change, you will get a chance to redeem a special achievement available to those who supported us from the beginning. [b]You'll just need to open the game to get this achievement! [/b]We're also planning on including exclusive renders attached to it.
[b](THIS ACHIEVEMENT WILL ONLY BE AVAILABLE UNTIL JANUARY 12)[/b]

After these changes happen, we will make available a supporter DLC for the old price. This DLC will have the same effect. So if you didn't get a chance to redeem it, please contact us on our support email to resolve the issue.

To end this announcement, we would like to thank you again for giving our game a chance. If you enjoyed it consider leaving a review to help us reach more people!

- Mr. Mister and team

notes.title: Clarification Regarding Recent Update
notes.content:
We would like to clarify that the recent update is an extension of Chapter 1, not the release of Chapter 2 as was mistakenly communicated. Chapter 2 is currently in development and will feature a much larger content offering, including approximately 20 new scenes.

We apologize for any confusion caused and appreciate your understanding. We hope you continue to enjoy the extended content in Chapter 1!

- Mr. Mister team

notes.title: Chapter 1 Extension Update Now Live!
notes.content:
The wait is over! We're thrilled to announce that the Chapter 1 Extension update of [i][b]Hunter: Space Pirates[/b][/i] is now available.

Continue your journey from where you left off at the end of Chapter 1, and dive deeper into the story with new characters that will to capture your attention. Plus, you'll have the opportunity to further develop your relationship with Betty!

Thank you for your continued support – we can't wait to hear your thoughts. Jump back in and experience the next chapter today!

notes.title: Restored Gralina Scene + NEW Videos for Mary
notes.content: With this update, we have restored the Gralina prize scene after the arena fight, as well as added some extra [b]spicy[/b] videos for Mary's bath scene!

notes.title: Deleted Scene Poll: Bradok and Gralina's Arena Moment
notes.content:
[b]Hello, everyone![/b]

We’d love to hear your thoughts on a scene we originally chose to remove. This moment takes place right after Bradok’s arena battle, where he has some special time with Gralina, the rival coach, as a reward for his victory.

We initially decided to cut this scene based on feedback around featuring additional intimate moments outside of those involving the MC. However, we want to make sure we’re giving you the best possible experience with our visual novel.

What do you think? Should we restore it in this version of the game? Your feedback is incredibly valuable for us, so feel free to share your thoughts in the comments!
